entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Android - Carousel View - always get an error "Can't set CarouselView to position -1. ItemsSource has 10 items." #32037
  • [XSG] input needs to be trimmed #32034
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • SwipeView Closes when Content Changes even with SwipeBehaviorOnInvoked="RemainOpen" (iOS only) #32033
  • Android - WebView in a grid expands beyond it's cell #32030
  • NavigationRootManager_ElementBasedFragment crash on armeabi-v7a in .NET 9 MAUI #32029
  • When using a barcode scanner, the Entry.Completed event is fired with previous content #32027
  • MediaElement exception #32026
  • Official Support for .NET MAUI on Linux #32023
  • Native library fails to load at runtime on Android devices with 16KB page size, despite the ELF file itself being correctly aligned to 16KB boundaries. #32021
  • Cannot use passkey/fido/webauthn in BlazorWebView. #32020
  • Image shifts downward when window is resized smaller #32017
  • iOS 26 - The MaxLength property value is not respected on an Entry control. #32016

Closed

  • V9.0.111 Release Notes Missing #32031
  • Shell TabBar always hide under navigation bar on Android 35 #26611
    Backlog
  • [NET10.0] Change all defaults of SafeAreaEdges so that they will return "None" as the default if the user hasn't set the value #31925
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • Allow use of new WebView2CompositionControl for WPF BlazorWebView #28063
    Backlog
